title: 0 A.D. (Empires Ascendant)
description: High-fidelity 3D RTS game of ancient warfare covering 500 B.C. to 500 A.D., featuring custom civilizations, naval warfare, and procedural maps.

title: The Battle for Wesnoth
description: Tactical high-fantasy strategy with 16 solo campaigns, hundreds of unit types, rich lore, map editor, and active online multiplayer.

title: OpenTTD
description: Open-source remake of Transport Tycoon Deluxe. Build rail networks, truck routes, flight paths, and shipping lanes with multiplayer support up to 255 players.

title: Shattered Pixel Dungeon
monetization: Free on PC / Android (Optional tip jar)
description: Deep turn-based roguelike with 5 playable hero classes, high replayability, procedural dungeon floors, and zero pay-to-win mechanics.

title: Lichess
description: The world's leading open-source chess server. Unlimited free computer analysis (Stockfish), tactics puzzles, tournaments, and master games.

title: Infinite Craft
monetization: Clean web page, zero intrusive popups
description: Combine basic elements (Water, Fire, Earth, Wind) to discover millions of emergent objects, concepts, and historical figures powered by generative AI.

title: GOG Free Games Collection
description: Curated collection of classic PC titles (Beneath a Steel Sky, Tyrian 2000, Lure of the Temptress, Postal) that you own forever with no DRM launcher required.

title: Epic Games Weekly Free Games Tracker
monetization: Standard commercial games given away for 100% off
description: Every Thursday, Epic Games makes 1-2 commercial PC games completely free to claim permanently. Once claimed during the free week, they remain in your library forever.
